labels.title: Label
labels.$comment: label associated to the instance of the peripheral, can be overridden at sample level. In this case it becomes read-only.

init_type.title: Resource initialization code generation
init_type.description: Generate or not the SPI init code, call it or not at boot
init_type.$comment: generate the init code of your SPI or not (enabled/disabled), call it automatically at startup or not (called/enabled)

data_width.title: Data size
data_width.description: Choose the size of a single data (multiples of 8 are recommended)

ExtendDataWidth.title: Non standard data sizes
ExtendDataWidth.description: Add the possibility to choose more data size

clock_source.title: Clock source
clock_source.description: Clock source can be modified in clock tree

clock_source_frequency.title: Clock source frequency
clock_source_frequency.description: Input clock frequency can be modified in clock tree

baud_rate_prescaler.title: Clock prescaler
baud_rate_prescaler.description: This prescaler divides the clock source frequency to get the final baud rate of SPI bus

baud_rate.title: Baud rate
baud_rate.description: Frequency of SPI peripheral clock source need to be lower than SPI APB bus frequency

clock_polarity.title: Clock polarity
clock_polarity.description: Choose level of clock signal when clock is in IDLE state

clock_phase.title: Clock phase
clock_phase.description: Choose if data is captured on first or second edge of the clock signal

nss_pin_management.title: NSS signal type (Chip select)
nss_pin_management.description: Choose if NSS signal is managed by software (Deactivated) or hardware (Activated)

SetFifoThreshold.title: FIFO Threshold

actions.message: Packet size exceed maximal FIFO size

SetFifoThreshold.description: Choose a multiple of data size to define a FIFO threshold

CRC_Polynomial.description: Set CRC generating polynomial as a 7, 8, 16 or 32-bit long value for a polynomial degree respectively equal to 7, 8, 16 or 32.

crc_tx_init_pattern.description: Init value to initiate TX CRC computation.
crc_tx_init_pattern.title: TX CRC init pattern

crc_rx_init_pattern.description: Init value to initiate RX CRC computation.
crc_rx_init_pattern.title: RX CRC init pattern

nss_pulse.description: Enable NSS pulse between two consecutive data frame transfers
nss_pulse.title: NSS pulse mode

nss_mssi_delay.title: Master SS Idleness
nss_mssi_delay.description: Time between the activation of chip select (NSS) and the first transferred data

underrun_configuration.description: Slave can send a constant pattern to the master or repeat the last pattern received from the master

SetMIDIdlenessDelay.title: Master Inter Data Idleness
SetMIDIdlenessDelay.description: Specifies minimum time delay inserted between two consecutive data frames (available in master mode only with Motorola protocol)

ReadyPinPolarity.title: Ready signal polarity

oneOf.title: High
oneOf.description: High level of the signal means the slave is ready for communication

oneOf.title: Low
oneOf.description: Low level of the signal means the slave is ready for communication

ReadyPinPolarity.description: Choose the signal level for which the slave is ready to communicate

EnableMosiMisoSwap.title: IO Swap
EnableMosiMisoSwap.description: Invert MOSI and MISO alternate functions

LockIOConfig.title: Lock IO Config
LockIOConfig.description: Lock the alternate function configuration of associated I/Os

EnableDMA_TX.title: DMA TX
EnableDMA_TX.description: Enable DMA TX mode for the peripheral.

EnableDMA_RX.title: DMA RX
EnableDMA_RX.description: Enable DMA RX mode for the peripheral.

EnableInterruption.title: Interruption
EnableInterruption.description: Enable interruption mode for the peripheral.
